name: langchain-stytch-agent-starter
description: B2B Explain Like I'm 5 chatbot with Stytch Connected Apps integration

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && npm run install:cli
scripts.clean:redis: echo '🧹 Cleaning Eli5 explanation cache...' && redis-cli --scan --pattern 'org:*:topics:*' | xargs -r redis-cli DEL && echo '✅ Explanation cache cleared'
scripts.clean:tokens: echo '🧹 Cleaning CLI authentication tokens...' && rm -rf ~/.eli5-history-cli/ && echo '✅ CLI tokens cleared'
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:redis && npm run clean:tokens && echo '🎉 Clean slate ready!'
